user.title: Bambu Filament Manager
user.description:
Printers found: {printers}.

Finish the setup or add another printer?

menu_options.cloud: Add another printer – Bambu cloud (read only)

printer.title: Connect printer
printer.description:
You find these on the printer:
• **IP address and access code:** Settings → Network / WLAN (on P1/A1/P2S in the “LAN mode” menu).
• **Serial number:** Settings → device info, or in Bambu Studio / Handy.

Tip: give the printer a fixed IP address in your router.

Turn on **developer mode** on the printer (LAN mode → developer mode), otherwise the printer does not accept commands and color/profile cannot be sent.

install_bambu.title: Bambu Lab integration missing
install_bambu.description:
The printer connection is handled by the **Bambu Lab** integration (ha-bambulab). To install it:

1. [Open Bambu Lab in the Marketplace]({link}) → **Download**.
2. **Restart** Home Assistant.
3. Open this setup again – then you only enter IP, serial number and access code.

connect.title: Connect printer
connect.description:
No Bambu Lab printer found yet. How should the printer be connected?

✅ **Local (LAN) with developer mode** is the recommended way: only then can the Filament Manager send color, profile and temperatures to the AMS.

menu_options.printer: Local (LAN): IP, serial number, access code – recommended, everything available
menu_options.cloud: Bambu cloud: account login – read only, no sending to the printer

cloud.title: Bambu cloud
cloud.description:
⚠️ **Note:** Through the cloud the Filament Manager can **only read** on current Bambu firmware (slots, colors, progress, usage). **Sending color, filament profile and temperatures to the printer only works in local LAN mode with developer mode enabled.** With the cloud you only link spools to slots and set color/profile on the printer or in Bambu Handy.

Sign in with your Bambu Lab account. Usually a code is sent by email afterwards.

cloud_code.title: Verification code
cloud_code.description: Bambu sent you a code ({where}). Enter it here. No code? Tick “Request a new code” and submit.

settings.title: Settings
settings.description: Messages are sent to all selected targets (text only). The list shows every notification service set up in your Home Assistant – e.g. mobile app, Telegram or WhatsApp if installed.

data.notify_scan: Message when a spool is scanned
data.notify_insufficient: Warn when a print needs more filament than left
data.scan_targets: Send the scan message with slot buttons to
data.notify_bed: Warn when the bed is set too cold
data.bed_auto_raise: Raise the bed automatically at print start

data_description.ignored_tags: Stickers you named yourself in HA are ignored anyway. Add automatically named ones (“Tag …”) here if they belong to something else (e.g. a door).
data_description.default_spool_weight: Used to compute the rest when weighing (scale shows filament + spool).
data_description.scan_targets: Empty = same targets as above. Phones (HA app) and Telegram get buttons for the slots, everything else text only.
data_description.notify_bed: At print start: bed target lower than the spool needs (the spool's own value, otherwise the Bambu Studio profile for printer and plate). With a button to raise it.
data_description.bed_auto_raise: If the bed is set colder than the spool needs (e.g. your own 110 °C for ASA), the Filament Manager raises it itself and only reports it. LAN developer mode only.

weigh_spool.name: Weigh spool
weigh_spool.description: Compute the rest from a scale reading (filament + spool).

assign_spool.name: Load spool into slot
assign_spool.description: Sends the spool to the AMS slot (profile, color, temperature).

send.name: Send to printer
send.description: Off = only link (when the slot is already set correctly).

unassign_tray.name: Unlink slot
unassign_tray.description: Forgets which spool is in the slot.

select_spool.name: Select spool
select_spool.description: Selects a spool as if scanned via NFC.

list_spools.name: List spools
list_spools.description: Returns all spools with their slot.
